entities.summary: Giovanni Battista Pininfarina was an Italian automobile designer and the founder of the Carrozzeria Pininfarina coachbuilding company, a name associated with many well known postwar cars. Battista Farina was a performers & entertainers from Turin (1893-11-02, Turin–1966-04-03). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
